title: US-045 Hotfix: cancelled installations can be back-dated again
description: Friday, 17:30. Planners cannot close the week: every back-dated cancellation is refused. Romain fixes the validation rule on a branch cut from preprod, which holds what production runs, and opens the hotfix Pull Request into preprod.
commitMessage:
US-045 Cancelled installations can no longer be back-dated

Installation_Date_Not_Past exempted Completed installations and not Cancelled
ones. A cancelled installation is finished work too.
prTitle: US-045 Hotfix: cancelled installations can be back-dated again
prBody:
Production is refusing every back-dated cancellation, and the planners cannot close the week.

- `Installation_Date_Not_Past`: Cancelled is exempt, like Completed

Cut from `preprod`, so it carries what production runs and nothing that waits in integration.

Story: US-045 in BACKLOG.md
nextStep: Review it and merge it into preprod, then release preprod to main. Lab 3.7 steps 3 and 4.
